blocks.text: D201 8150 207 STREET Willoughby Heights Langley V2Y 4J5

parts.t: UNION PARK by POLYGON! This 1-bed 1 bath listing features over 600 SQFT with overheight ceilings, laminate wood flooring, and a deck off the living room to a gourmet kitchen, engineered stone countertops & stainless steel appliances! Take advantage of the 12,000 SQFT amenities building which features a Pool, Hot tub, Indoor Basketball Court, Gym, Kids Playground, and so much more! This is a great home, with unmatched amenities and a home that was built with integrity. Resort Living in the heart of Willoughby! 1 Parking & 1 Storage included!
